To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a cycle with mean teletext response time close to its lower bound can be obtained by broadcasting pages in decreasing order of popularity, where the popularity of a page is defined as the fraction of users that will request it.
a lower bound on the mean response time can be obtained by the formula and the design procedure presented in this paper.

the mean response time in a teletext system is a function of the number and order of pages broadcast in a cycle, that the lower bound for mean response time is a function of page size and the total number of pages, and that a procedure is available for constructing cycles that are near-optimum in terms of mean response time.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of how to design a teletext system so that it can be used efficiently by a large number of users.
the design of the broadcast cycle of a teletext system.
the problem of designing a broadcast cycle that minimizes the average response time of a teletext system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the design of teletext broadcast cycles is a complex and important task, and that the results presented in this paper are useful for the design of such cycles.
a cycle designed using the procedure described in this paper is a good cycle.
the design procedure presented in this paper yields a teletext broadcast schedule with the minimum mean response time for a given number of pages and given number of users.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have provided a method to determine an optimal broadcast cycle.
we have developed a method for designing teletext broadcast cycles that yields cycles with mean response time very near the theoretical lower bound.
a cycle designed according to our method will provide the user with a response time that is within a few percent of the minimum possible for the given system.

the broadcast cycle can be designed to reduce the mean response time.
the design of teletext cycles is a non-trivial task.
